purpose: Move every original character portrait onto the visual language established by the user-provided Albina baseline without altering the authorized albina-visual-v2 source index.

candidateStyleBoard.derivation: Six 384x384 crops from the baseline interior safe area are mirrored or reordered, upscaled to 512x512, and tiled as a 2x3 board. The selected crops exclude the face, complete body silhouette, standing pose, poster composition, typography, L-CORP mark, barcode, and readable text while retaining continuous ink lines, cel-shading transitions, white-black-gold-warning-red material language, industrial cold light, armor panel seams, and Fascia surface detail.

migrationContract: All 27 character portraits must stay on the WisArt reference-edit pipe; Latent has no image input and therefore cannot perform image-level style migration.
The candidate board may be used only as the final style input. It must not be used as an identity, pose, anatomy, costume, object, or composition source.
The source board remains production-reference-only and redistribution-forbidden.
This document does not authorize promotion, release, or distribution; those remain separate release and rights workflows.
The existing albina-visual-v2 source index and its authorization are intentionally unchanged.
Local generation does not require a human authorization artifact; current source, prompt, plan, and style-board hashes remain runtime validation inputs.
automatedProductionRequirements: Build a versioned canon source index and matching prompt/plan freeze rather than mutating albina-visual-v2 in place.
Validate the current source index, candidate board hash, prompt freeze, plan job set, canon claims, provider contract, and output review state before production.
Keep promotion, release, distribution, and rights checks outside this local-production policy.
